status: Planned acceptance checks; not executed tests
scope: Native Penpot preset interaction contract; runtime/provider/accessibility acceptance separate

textInput.behavior: Open a labelled input overlay with complete synthetic value, missing-required and invalid examples; Apply creates a visibly changed preset; Cancel returns to invoking form.
textInput.critical: Do not imply arbitrary keyboard text entry or that a hidden value was accepted.

privateInput.behavior: Only masked synthetic completed-state text; upload/evidence ref never an expected ownership answer.
privateInput.critical: Private answer must not appear in public, relay, export or logs.

select.behavior: Open native choice overlay; active option and selected field text change in the resulting preset; include unavailable/disabled options with explanation.
select.critical: No no-op choice that silently returns to unchanged field.

checkbox.behavior: Checked/unchecked variants visibly change state and validation eligibility; decline/cancel preserves input.
checkbox.critical: Prerequisite checkbox must guard consequential CTA, not decorate it.

consentToggle.behavior: Explicit off/on/withdrawn presets and saved confirmation; verified contact/provider adoption gates enabling.
consentToggle.critical: Disabled provider/device permission cannot be enabled by toggle.

tableRow.behavior: Whole labelled row opens its corresponding detail or outcome; current row may remain selected; paging/filter/sort create distinct presets.
tableRow.critical: Unknown, empty, denied, mismatched and confirmed outcomes stay separate.

tabs.behavior: Each tab selects visible content/current style and a relevant result population; return preserves context.
tabs.critical: No decorative non-channel tabs; accessible table remains available.

upload.behavior: Chooser offers synthetic attached, uploading, interrupted, quarantined, failed and sanitised-preview outcomes; remove/retry confirmed.
upload.critical: No real upload, file dialog or preview before isolation approval.

criticalAction.behavior: Required fields and prerequisites -> review overlay -> explicit simulated current-authority result -> distinct success/blocked/unknown receipt. Cancel/back retain prior state.
criticalAction.critical: No automatic provider success, money transfer, custody release or privilege grant.

externalHandoff.behavior: Explicit external-provider/IdP simulator overlay with cancel, denied, expired, unknown and confirmed sample options.
externalHandoff.critical: No live credential, payment, provider send or membership grant.

regionMask.behavior: Keyboard/numeric-equivalent region choices, paint/erase/reset presets, visible mask preview, out-of-bounds/dimension mismatch and metadata-only branches.
regionMask.critical: Viewport/mask sample never certifies identity or facial recognition.

printTag.behavior: Native print-preview overlay, generic tag artwork and back/cancel; rotate/revoke confirmation and unavailable finder state.
printTag.critical: Artwork has no live token or owner/contact data.

navigation.behavior: All primary/secondary/back/sidebar/menu/link controls have meaningful destinations; modal close cancels; terminal views can return to entry or launcher.
navigation.critical: Do not substitute launcher or scenario menu reachability for working in-flow controls.

statusScenario.behavior: Reviewer-only scenario picker labels all outcomes as synthetic. Operational CTA remains guarded independently.
statusScenario.critical: Scenario choices must not relabel rejection/unknown as success.

export.behavior: Format and privacy-scope presets -> confirmation -> approved/suppressed/no-data/denied outcomes with safe preview; cancel unchanged.
export.critical: No raw private contact/evidence or actual file export required.

cases.name: identity success
cases.expected: A05 only after explicit confirmed IdP result; membership is checked separately.

cases.name: recovery and denial
cases.expected: Recovery is enumeration-safe; denied workspace loads no private records.

cases.name: expired session
cases.expected: No automatic replay of critical operations.

cases.name: complete report
cases.expected: Original input remains retained after revision.

cases.name: invalid and offline
cases.expected: Invalid submission preserves draft; offline save is not server receipt.

cases.name: upload failure
cases.expected: Preview unavailable before sanitisation; no success implied.

cases.name: candidate
cases.expected: Possible match is not ownership.

cases.name: no data and partial route
cases.expected: No candidates, delayed routes and unavailable evidence are distinct.

cases.name: identity conflict
cases.expected: Hard identity contradiction prevents claim progression even at high similarity.

cases.name: private claim
cases.expected: Submission ends pending independent review; preset private values remain masked.

cases.name: representative and rejection
cases.expected: C09 is rejection and must not issue a pass.

cases.name: withdrawal and rate limit
cases.expected: Cancel withdrawal returns to C07; attempt limit discloses no expected answer.

cases.name: authorised physical return
cases.expected: Independent approval, current policy/holds/custody, valid pass, actual recipient and item are separate prerequisites; role sessions remain labelled.

cases.name: pass blocked
cases.expected: Expired, held, wrong-desk or used pass cannot record a return.

cases.name: cancel return
cases.expected: Open return confirmation then cancel; token and custody unchanged.

cases.name: staffed acceptance
cases.expected: Finder report alone leaves possession with finder. Actual nominated receiver and current generation required.

cases.name: stale acceptance
cases.expected: A stale observation does not overwrite custody; inspect current state.

cases.name: cancel handover
cases.expected: Cancel confirmation retains original custody.

cases.name: approved phrase
cases.expected: Only approved phrase catalogue; queued is distinct from sent/delivered.

cases.name: moderation
cases.expected: Flag or block requires confirmation and minimal scoped evidence; cancellation preserves thread state.

cases.name: template editing
cases.expected: Tabs work; source and target review independent; unavailable target locale cannot publish.

cases.name: consent
cases.expected: Explicit consent on/off and withdrawal have distinct saved preset states; disabled provider cannot enable.

cases.name: provider uncertainty
cases.expected: N05 only through explicit signed confirmed-delivery sample; reconcile may remain unknown and never changes custody.

cases.name: confirmed booking and handoff
cases.expected: Q04 reachable for operational handoff only with explicitly confirmed booking, consent, current authority and no hold. Q07 records courier possession only.

cases.name: quote and dispatch failures
cases.expected: Expired quote, revoked consent, hold or stale generation block dispatch.

cases.name: unknown reconciliation
cases.expected: Unknown stays unknown; NOT_FOUND only permits the identical durable operation resend.

cases.name: cancellation
cases.expected: Q08 only confirmed cancellation before dispatch. Cancel modal returns with no operation mutation.

cases.name: owner receipt
cases.expected: Tracking delivery alone is insufficient; explicit physical receipt and current authority required.

cases.name: transit authority change
cases.expected: Independent current reauthorization precedes owner confirmation; original dispatch retained.

cases.name: cancel receipt
cases.expected: Cancelling receipt leaves owner-return unconfirmed.

cases.name: optional reserve and settle
cases.expected: Terms fixed before reservation; explicit confirmed reserve, owner receipt and valid settlement permission required; payment never gates recovery.

cases.name: declined or unknown
cases.expected: Decline credits no escrow; unknown operation reconciles before another send.

cases.name: reviewed refund
cases.expected: Refund request must pass independent review and confirmation; W10 requires explicit provider confirmation.

cases.name: unsupported reversal
cases.expected: Unsupported, declined or unknown reversal retains original settlement and invents no recovered money.

cases.name: cancel financial intent
cases.expected: Cancel resolution before queueing; immutable terms and ledger unchanged.

cases.name: QR and NFC
cases.expected: Print/write action uses illustrated QR; T07 only explicit successful device read-back sample.

cases.name: failed NFC
cases.expected: Failed or unsupported write offers retry and QR fallback; no success assumption.

cases.name: revocation and finder
cases.expected: Revoked old locator cannot remain active; rotation creates distinct replacement. Scan is not ownership.

cases.name: cancel revoke
cases.expected: Cancel preserves current tag state.

cases.name: staff queue and evidence
cases.expected: Queue rows and filters act; private evidence access requires purpose and task scope; expected answers remain secret.

cases.name: competing claims and hold
cases.expected: Conflict/active hold blocks release rather than merely reducing a score.

cases.name: cancel scoped access
cases.expected: Cancel retains masked evidence.

cases.name: accept receiver custody
cases.expected: Only nominated receiver can confirm physical possession at current generation; one append-only custody event.

cases.name: stale and incident
cases.expected: Stale update alone does not create a missing-item incident. Explicit inspected incident creates hold; current authoritative location is preserved.

cases.name: cancel acceptance
cases.expected: No implicit transfer on cancellation.

cases.name: eligible disposition
cases.expected: Adopted institutional policy, no active holds/claims, current versions, authorised recipient and actual completed physical action required.

cases.name: blocked and cancel
cases.expected: Changed check blocks terminal action. Cancel confirmation returns to DPO2 and does not record disposition.

cases.name: region and mask approval
cases.expected: Exact camera/time/purpose/expiry/budget and independent crop disclosure approval before reads/exports.

cases.name: invalid region
cases.expected: Out-of-bounds coordinates or absent/mismatched mask prevent pixel disclosure; metadata-only is distinct.

cases.name: revoke and purge
cases.expected: Revocation stops future access immediately; purge pending, completed and legal-hold retained outcomes are distinct. Cancel leaves grant unchanged.

cases.name: peer trust review
cases.expected: Peer-local rank retained; trust/keys review uses protected references and explicit bilateral policy.

cases.name: withdrawn offer dispute
cases.expected: Opaque origin attribution, no private evidence/contact export; no local custody mutation from peer offer.

cases.name: append correction
cases.expected: Original native custody fact remains unchanged; correction appends reference and reason.

cases.name: async capture state
cases.expected: 202 accepted/pending, confirmed capture and rejected/unavailable are selectable distinct sample results; cancel retains original event.

cases.name: operator request
cases.expected: Local membership changes are prepared/tracked operator requests, never public API grant; IdP lifecycle external.

cases.name: policy version
cases.expected: Current expected version and impact review required; conflict stops change; existing passes rechecked.

cases.name: cancel policy
cases.expected: No policy or membership mutation from Cancel.

cases.name: privacy request
cases.expected: Authenticated private scope, retention/legal hold and derivative propagation are explicit.

cases.name: held deletion and cancel
cases.expected: Held, accepted/pending and completed-with-manifest are separate results; no blanket immediate delete. Cancel does not remove records.

cases.name: scoped connector
cases.expected: No actual secret shown; current bounded origin, permitted scope and independent external acceptance remain explicit.

cases.name: source permission
cases.expected: Source terms/provenance and publication review distinct from truth/ownership confidence.

cases.name: failed callback
cases.expected: Bad signature, replay and expiry fail closed without raw payload or secret leakage.

cases.name: locale handoff
cases.expected: Qualified target-locale review required; not automatically published.

cases.name: restore readiness
cases.expected: Metadata health does not grant tenant evidence access; erasure replay barrier precedes serving.

cases.name: unknown operation
cases.expected: Reconcile original operation; no blind new send. Cancel provider/quota review has no runtime effect.

cases.name: governed activation
cases.expected: Fully reviewed package is a separately labelled synthetic state; incomplete G04 cannot activate. Independent approvals and current compare-and-swap version required.

cases.name: invalid and rollback
cases.expected: Invalid source/consent/splits block freeze; rollback target still permitted; stale comparison applies no switch.

cases.name: cancel approval
cases.expected: Cancel preserves active snapshot and evidence history.

cases.name: tenant report and export
cases.expected: Filters/tabs work; chart and table population/denominator consistent. Export excludes secrets and suppresses small groups.

cases.name: uncertainty and consent
cases.expected: Observed and inferred paths distinct; unavailable estimate is not zero; hardware optional/disabled until adoption.

cases.name: cancel export
cases.expected: No download/private rows loaded from cancel. Suppressed/no-data/denied outcomes selectable separately.

cases.name: responsive states
cases.expected: All controls remain reachable across narrow, medium, wide, enlarged text and long-locale states.

cases.name: modal validation
cases.expected: Missing reason blocks confirm; corrected preset required; Cancel closes and restores invoking context; do not claim runtime focus testing from diagram.

cases.name: staff responsive
cases.expected: Current receiver/generation and physical return guards remain identical across breakpoints.

cases.name: failure recovery
cases.expected: Interrupted upload, quarantine, required detail and reconnect are distinct; preserve draft and explicit retry.

cases.name: access and safety
cases.expected: No private records on denied/expired context; no replay of payment, custody or release.
